tools.title: Quantum & AI Research Stack
tools.description: Tools and frameworks used for quantum-circuit optimization, hybrid quantum-classical learning, deep learning, and reproducible research.

sections.title: Research Workflow
paragraphs: The research stack combines Qiskit and PennyLane for quantum and hybrid quantum-classical experiments with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-learn for classical learning, reinforcement learning, and benchmarking.
Python, GPU/CUDA programming, PostgreSQL, and LaTeX support experimentation, data handling, technical visualization, and reproducible research documentation.
